test_processor_creation: test that LightOnOcrProcessor can be created and has a tokenizer and image_processor
test_processor_with_text_only: test the LightOnOcrProcessor with text-only input and verify input_ids and attention_mask are returned
test_processor_with_image_and_text: test the LightOnOcrProcessor with image and text inputs and verify pixel_values and image_sizes are returned
test_processor_batch_processing: test the LightOnOcrProcessor with a batch of images and texts and verify batch size is correct
test_processor_special_tokens: test that LightOnOcrProcessor special tokens like image_token and image_break_token are properly registered
